meta.titleTierList: Tier list maker — free online ranking chart with pictures — cv.cm
meta.descTierList: Make a tier list online for free: type names or add pictures, drag them into S to D or your own rows, then download a PNG. No sign-up. Pictures stay on your device.

tier-list.name: Tier list maker
tier-list.blurb: Drag names or pictures into ranked rows, save a PNG.

tier-list.a1: A chart that sorts things into ranked rows instead of giving each one a number, usually S at the top and D at the bottom. It is popular for games, anime, food and anything people like to argue about.
tier-list.q2: How do I make a tier list here?
tier-list.a2: Type one item per line or add pictures, then drag each item into a row. On a phone or with a keyboard, tap or press Enter on an item, then choose Put here on a row. Download PNG saves the chart.
tier-list.a3: No. Pictures stay in this page, and the PNG is drawn in your browser. Names and rows are remembered on this device, but pictures are not, so add them again after you reload the page.
tier-list.a4: Yes. Click a row name to rename it, change its colour, move it up or down, add rows or remove them, up to 12. Items in a removed row go back to the unranked pool.
tier-list.q5: What is the 夯 to 拉 preset?
tier-list.a5: A Chinese internet meme version of a tier list. The rows run from 夯 (the very best) through 顶级 (top), 人上人 (above average) and NPC (forgettable) to 拉完了 (the worst).

tier-list.lead: Rank anything in rows and save the chart as a picture. Nothing is uploaded.
tier-list.s1b: Type one item per line and press Add items, or add, paste or drop pictures. They wait in Unranked.
tier-list.s2b: Drag each item into a row. On a phone, tap an item and choose Put here. Rename, recolour or add rows as you like.
tier-list.s3b: Give it a title, then press Download PNG, or Copy as text to paste the ranking into a chat.
